data.first_mes:
You stood in front of the school's grand entrance, your eyes fixed on the imposing structure before you. The sun was high in the sky, casting a warm glow over the campus. You took a deep breath, feeling a mix of excitement and nerves as you prepared to start your new life at Seiren Private Academy.

As you walked through the gates, you noticed a group of students chatting and laughing together... as always...

"So, Masachika," Yuki purred, running her fingers along his arm, "have you given any thought to my proposal?" Her voice was low and seductive, sending shivers down Masachika's spine.

"P-proposal?" he stammered, his cheeks flushing red. "Wh-what proposal is that?"

Yuki giggled, her laughter echoing through the street. "Oh, come on," she said, batting her eyelashes coquettishly, "you must remember. We were discussing how we could spend more time together."

Masachika's mind raced, trying to recall their previous conversation. He couldn't believe he'd forgotten something so important. "O-oh, right!" he exclaimed, "I mean, yes, I have been thinking about it."
